# RAIJIN ZAN Test Analysis

## Image 1 — End of Dual Hold (charge complete)

1. **HUD status text:** "EMPTY HAND / SHEATHED" with "[U] READY" on the right side of the panel.
2. **Charge strip:** Filled — bright green segment at the left end of the thin strip below the stamina bar (only a small portion filled, the "power ready" charge pips).
3. **Pose:** Upright planted stance, sword held low and pointed down-back at an angle — not a deep coil; player looks stationary, preparing to release. No visible crouch.
4. **Sword:** DRAWN — blade visible, extending down-left with a glowing cyan hilt ring.
5. **Effects:** No slash trail, no afterimages, no speed lines. Rain only.
6. **Alive:** Yes — full health 100/100.
7. **Stamina:** 600 / 600.
8. **Enemies:** None on screen yet ("WAVE 1 / HOSTILES INBOUND" banner showing). Kills 0, hostiles 4.

## Image 2 — ~0.17s After Release (dash-slash in flight)

1. **HUD status text:** Still "EMPTY HAND / SHEATHED" with "[U] READY" (status not yet updated mid-move).
2. **Charge strip:** Green charge segment still visible/filled at left end of strip.
3. **Pose:** Neutral upright running/standing stance — **not** a horizontal flying dash. Player appears near-identical to Image 1, just shifted slightly right. ❗ No extended-blade dash pose visible.
4. **Sword:** DRAWN — same down-back blade angle with cyan hilt ring.
5. **Effects:** **No motion trail, no afterimage ghosts, no speed lines.** Only ambient rain streaks. ❗ The move reads as having not launched.
6. **Alive:** Yes — 100/100.
7. **Stamina:** 600 / 600 (no cost deducted).
8. **Enemies:** One enemy visible ahead-left (white stickman with blade, red visor) but **not hit** — no damage numbers, no hit flash. Kills still 0, hostiles still 4.

## Image 3 — ~1s After (recovery)

1. **HUD status text:** "EMPTY HAND / SHEATHED" / "[U] READY".
2. **Charge strip:** Same green filled segment at strip's left end.
3. **Pose:** Upright running/advancing stance — a normal run, **not** a standing recovery guard. Player has moved slightly right.
4. **Sword:** DRAWN — blade still down-back, unchanged.
5. **Effects:** None — no trail, ghosts, or speed effects.
6. **Alive:** Yes — 100/100.
7. **Stamina:** 600 / 600.
8. **Enemies:** Three enemies now visible ahead (two on the left, one engaged near player at the third enemy's position) but **no damage numbers, no hit reactions**. Kills 0, hostiles 4 — unchanged.

## Verdict

The RAIJIN ZAN input **does not appear to trigger**. Across all three frames:

- No deep coil pose at hold-end
- No horizontal flying-dash pose, blade extension, or motion trail after release
- No afterimage ghosts at any point
- Stamina never decreases (600/600 constant)
- No enemies hit, no damage numbers, kills counter unchanged
- HUD status text never changes from "EMPTY HAND / SHEATHED"

The character behaves identically in all three screenshots apart from normal movement and enemies spawning — the hold L+K → release both input appears unregistered or unimplemented in this build.
